 HoopsHype Nov. 2, 2026, 11:33 a.m. ET The Detroit native, who still holds the program record for assists at Division II Hillsdale College in Michigan, pivoted from the hardwood to the golf course after a series of injuries derailed his plan of playing professionally in Europe. Fodor was minding his business on a South Carolina driving range when a couple of men approached him to inquire about his former pastime. “Hey Rob, we heard you play basketball,” Fodor recalled the men saying. Without looking up from his swing stance, Fodor told them: “You guys heard wrong.”
